en.title: Hacker News: GPT-6 Astra in code review: Benefits, privacy, and cost
en.hook: GPT-6 Astra boosts code review productivity but raises privacy concerns and costs.

Privacy and data security concerns have been raised.
Cost efficiency and scalability remain uncertain.
